method.rasterization: Pillow EXIF orientation applied; RGBA composited onto opaque white
method.baseline: PNG lossless encode/decode; demo metadata written but never consulted by detector
method.parameters: All dimensions and editing operations are recorded per result
method.metadataAssertions: Separate setup checks confirm baseline/demo metadata present and stripped metadata absent; metadata never enters detectTrace.

extraAlignedTopCrop.rule: crop top 8 * bits/gcd(bits,floor(width/8)) pixels, preserving width; skip above half height or below three repetitions
